answer.reason: Two marked verses say something happened or was foretold in the valley beyond the summary: the enemy camp in Gideon's day and the LORD's word about breaking Israel's bow.

clauses.english: was where the Midianites and Amalekites pitched their camp against Israel
clauses.quote: pitched in the valley of Jezreel

clauses.english: was where the LORD said he would break the bow of Israel
clauses.quote: I will break the bow of Israel, in the valley of Jezreel.

doubts: JOS 17:16 only says Canaanites with iron chariots lived near it, which the summary already covers, so it is left out.
1SA 31:7 and 1CH 10:7 say only 'the valley' without naming Jezreel, so they are not used.
